title: React Native Developer
description: A roadmap for shipping Android and iOS apps with React Native, Expo, navigation, APIs, native modules, testing, and app store release.

tree.name: JavaScript, React, and React Native Basics
tree.description: Learn modern JavaScript, React components, hooks, styling, platform differences, and mobile UI primitives.

resources.title: React Native Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
React Native First Mobile App (Sheryians Coding School)
React Native Android and iOS App Development (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: JavaScript and React
children.description: Use ES modules, async/await, hooks, props, state, effects, context, and reusable components.

children.name: Core Components and Styling
children.description: Build screens with View, Text, ScrollView, FlatList, Image, Pressable, StyleSheet, and responsive layouts.

tree.name: Navigation, State, and Data
tree.description: Build real app flows with navigation stacks, server state, forms, auth, local storage, and loading/error states.

children.name: Navigation Patterns
children.description: Implement tabs, stacks, drawers, deep links, auth gates, modals, and screen lifecycle handling.

children.name: APIs, Forms, and Storage
children.description: Call APIs, validate forms, cache responses, store tokens, handle refresh, and support offline fallback.

children.name: Practice: Native Feature Spike
children.description: Prototype camera/location/notifications, document permissions, edge cases, and platform differences.

tree.name: Native Features and Quality
tree.description: Use device capabilities, animation, testing, performance profiling, crash reporting, and native module escape hatches.

children.name: Device APIs
children.description: Use camera, notifications, location, files, permissions, biometrics, app links, and background tasks.

children.name: Testing and Performance
children.description: Write component and E2E tests, profile slow lists, avoid unnecessary renders, and monitor production errors.

tree.name: Release and Portfolio
tree.description: Build, sign, distribute, update, and present a polished cross-platform mobile app.

children.name: Build and Store Workflow
children.description: Create development, preview, and production builds, manage signing, OTA updates, release notes, and store assets.

children.name: Project: Delivery Tracker App
children.description: Build a React Native app with auth, maps/location, push notifications, API data, offline mode, tests, and release checklist.
